notes.title: First Update: Beta Milestone
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone!
For our first "official" communication, I wanted to share with you a video made during our "beta" test:

[previewyoutube=T23jM9d7Rzk;full][/previewyoutube]

So far the game has a bit more than half of its content in and playable, and most of the art on the second half is done. We are hoping to be gold this Fall, and are still on track to be able to ship by the end of the year.
Thanks to those of you that wishlisted the game, and we are looking forward to giving you regular updates, as the game nears completion!
